metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM filtering parser for Aruba Networks ClearPass
properties.query:
let HostnameFormatRegex = @'^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$';
let DomainFormatRegex = @'^([_a-zA-Z0-9][_a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,62}\.)*[a-zA-Z]{2,63}$';
let vimAuthenticationArubaNetworksClearPass = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , endtime: datetime = datetime(null)
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , srchostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , targetappname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , eventresult: string = '*'
    , eventresultdetails_in: dynamic = dynamic([])
    , disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    // Scope to actual authentication-decision events (RADIUS/TACACS+ logon attempts).
    // RADIUS/TACACS+ Accounting (2002/2004) carry no logon outcome and are session/traffic
    // accounting. Guest Access (2006) is a session-log echo without reliable outcome
    // or source fields. Audit Records (3xxx) and System Events (4xxx) are
    // administrative/config activity, not end-user or device authentication.
    CommonSecurityLog
    | where not(disabled)
    | where DeviceVendor == "Aruba Networks" and DeviceProduct == "ClearPass"
    // 2000: "Logged in users", 2001: "Failed Authentications", 2003 "TACACS+ Administration".
    | where DeviceEventClassID in ("2000", "2001", "2003")
    // Drop rows with no device or source identity (mandatory Dvc would be blank).
    | where isnotempty(DeviceAddress) or isnotempty(SourceIP)
    | where
        (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or "Logon" in (eventtype_in) // Source doesn't provide Logoff or Elevate
    | where
        array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SourceIP, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
        or ipv6_is_in_any_range(SourceIP, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    // Hostname may appear as host/<fqdn> in DestinationUserName when SourceHostName is absent. Often just an IP is reported.
    | where
        array_length(srchostname_has_any) == 0
        or SourceIP has_any (srchostname_has_any)
        or DestinationUserName has_any (srchostname_has_any)
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or DestinationUserName has_any (username_has_any)
    // TargetAppName is the ClearPass service (DestinationServiceName).
    | where array_length(targetappname_has_any) == 0 or DestinationServiceName has_any (targetappname_has_any)
    | extend
        // 2000/2001 imply the outcome. 2003 relies on Login Status.
        EventResult = case(
            DeviceEventClassID == "2000", "Success"
            , DeviceEventClassID == "2001", "Failure"
            , DeviceCustomString1Label == "Login Status" and DeviceCustomString1 == "ACCEPT", "Success"
            , DeviceCustomString1Label == "Login Status" and DeviceCustomString1 in ("REJECT", "TIMEOUT"), "Failure"
            , "NA")
    | where eventresult == '*' or eventresult == EventResult
    | extend
        EventResultDetails = case(
            EventResult != "Failure", ""
            , Reason has "User not found", "No such user"
            , Reason has "disabled", "User disabled"
            , Reason has "Password expired", "Password expired"
            , Reason has "expired", "Account expired"
            , Reason has "locked", "User locked"
            , isnotempty(Reason), "Other"
            , "")
    | where array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0 or EventResultDetails in (eventresultdetails_in)
    | parse-kv AdditionalExtensions as (
        ArubaClearpassCommonNASName: string
        , ArubaClearpassCommonConnectionStatus: string
        , ArubaClearpassRADIUSAuthMethod: string
        , ArubaClearpassTACACSRequestType: string
    ) with (pair_delimiter=";", kv_delimiter="=")
    // TACACS AUTHORIZATION is privilege checking, not a logon. Keep AUTHEN /
    // TACACS_AUTHENTICATION, and 2003 rows with no request type (older exports).
    | where
        DeviceEventClassID != "2003"
        or isempty(ArubaClearpassTACACSRequestType)
        or ArubaClearpassTACACSRequestType in ("TACACS_AUTHENTICATION", "AUTHEN")
    // The RADIUS method is exported either as requestMethod or as an unmapped extension.
    | extend
        _AuthMethod = iff(isnotempty(ArubaClearpassRADIUSAuthMethod), ArubaClearpassRADIUSAuthMethod, RequestMethod)
    | extend
        // Machine identities stay in TargetUsername (RADIUS User-Name), typed as Machine.
        // Require Machine Authenticated without User Authenticated dual tags are common on
        // human 802.1X (e.g. CORP\user) and must stay Regular.
        _IsMachineIdentity = case(
            _AuthMethod == "MAC-AUTH", true
            , DestinationUserPrivileges has "Machine Authenticated"
                and DestinationUserPrivileges !has "User Authenticated", true
            , DestinationUserName startswith "host/", true
            , DestinationUserName endswith "$", true
            , DestinationUserName matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$", true
            , DestinationUserName matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{2}([:\-][0-9a-fA-F]{2}){5}$", true
            , false)
        // host/<fqdn> is the 802.1X computer SPN. Reuse the FQDN as the source host.
        , _HostSpn = iff(DestinationUserName startswith "host/", substring(DestinationUserName, 5), "")
    | extend
        _SrcFQDN = iff(isnotempty(_HostSpn) and _HostSpn contains ".", _HostSpn, "")
        , _SrcHostnameFromSpn = case(
            isempty(_HostSpn), ""
            , _HostSpn contains ".", tostring(split(_HostSpn, ".")[0])
            , _HostSpn)
        , _SrcDomainFromSpn = iff(
            _HostSpn contains "."
            , tostring(substring(_HostSpn, indexof(_HostSpn, ".") + 1))
            , "")
        // Normalize host/<fqdn> SPNs to the short hostname. Domain goes to TargetDomain.
        , _TargetUsernameCandidate = case(
            isempty(_HostSpn), DestinationUserName
            , iff(_HostSpn contains ".", tostring(split(_HostSpn, ".")[0]), _HostSpn))
    | extend
        // Drop MOTD/banner fragments that leak into User-Name on some TACACS failures.
        _IsGarbageUsername = case(
            isempty(_TargetUsernameCandidate), false
            , strlen(_TargetUsernameCandidate) > 64, true
            , _TargetUsernameCandidate startswith " ", true
            , _TargetUsernameCandidate endswith " ", true
            , _TargetUsernameCandidate has "*", true
            , _TargetUsernameCandidate has "  ", true
            , false)
    | extend
        _TargetUsername = iff(_IsGarbageUsername, "", _TargetUsernameCandidate)
    | extend
        TargetUserType = case(
            _IsMachineIdentity, "Machine"
            , isnotempty(_TargetUsername), "Regular"
            , "Other")
        , TargetOriginalUserType = case(
            DestinationUserPrivileges has "Machine Authenticated"
                or DestinationUserPrivileges has "User Authenticated"
                , DestinationUserPrivileges
            , _AuthMethod == "MAC-AUTH", "MAC-AUTH"
            , "")
        , TargetUsernameType = case(
            isempty(_TargetUsername), ""
            , _TargetUsername contains "@", "UPN"
            , _TargetUsername contains @"\", "Windows"
            , "Simple")
        , _UserDomain = case(
            DestinationUserName contains "@", tostring(split(DestinationUserName, "@")[1])
            , DestinationUserName contains @"\", tostring(split(DestinationUserName, @"\")[0])
            , isnotempty(_SrcDomainFromSpn), _SrcDomainFromSpn
            , "")
        , TargetSimpleUsername = case(
            isempty(_TargetUsername), ""
            , _TargetUsername contains "@", tostring(split(_TargetUsername, "@")[0])
            , _TargetUsername contains @"\", tostring(split(_TargetUsername, @"\")[-1])
            , _TargetUsername)
        , TargetUserUpn = iff(_TargetUsername contains "@", _TargetUsername, "")
        , TargetWindowsUsername = iff(_TargetUsername contains @"\", _TargetUsername, "")
        , LogonMethod = case(
            _AuthMethod contains "TLS", "PKI"
            , _AuthMethod contains "PEAP"
                or _AuthMethod contains "MSCHAP"
                or _AuthMethod contains "PAP", "Username & Password"
            , isnotempty(_AuthMethod), "Other"
            , "")
        // Hostname-shaped NAS names identify the network device being accessed.
        , _TargetHostname = case(
            DestinationHostName matches regex HostnameFormatRegex, DestinationHostName
            , ArubaClearpassCommonNASName matches regex HostnameFormatRegex, ArubaClearpassCommonNASName
            , "")
        // TACACS+ Administration is an interactive admin logon to the network device. RADIUS
        // 802.1X/MAC-AUTH network access has no clean match in the ASIM EventSubType .
        , EventSubType = case(DeviceEventClassID == "2003", "RemoteInteractive", "")
        , EventSeverity = case(
            toint(LogSeverity) >= 7, "High"
            , toint(LogSeverity) >= 4, "Medium"
            , toint(LogSeverity) >= 0, "Low"
            , "Informational")
    | extend
        _UserDomainOk = _UserDomain matches regex DomainFormatRegex
        , _SrcDomainOk = _SrcDomainFromSpn matches regex DomainFormatRegex
        , _SrcHostnameOk = _SrcHostnameFromSpn matches regex HostnameFormatRegex
        // TacacsPrivilegeLevel only needed when packing AdditionalFields.
        , _IsTacacsPrivilege = iff(pack, DestinationUserPrivileges matches regex @"^\d+$", false)
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , pack(
                "DeviceEventCategory", DeviceEventCategory
                , "LoginStatus", iff(DeviceCustomString1Label == "Login Status", DeviceCustomString1, "")
                , "ErrorCode", FieldDeviceCustomNumber1
                , "SystemPostureToken", DeviceCustomString4
                , "ConnectionStatus", ArubaClearpassCommonConnectionStatus
                , "EnforcementProfile", iff(_IsTacacsPrivilege, "", DestinationUserPrivileges)
                , "TacacsPrivilegeLevel", iff(_IsTacacsPrivilege, DestinationUserPrivileges, "")
                , "AuthMethod", _AuthMethod
                , "NasName", ArubaClearpassCommonNASName
                , "OriginalUsername", DestinationUserName)
            , dynamic(null))
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , EventCount = toint(1)
        , EventStartTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventEndTime = TimeGenerated
        , EventType = "Logon"
        , EventSubType
        , EventResult
        , EventResultDetails
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = Reason
        , EventProduct = "ClearPass"
        , EventProductVersion = DeviceVersion
        , EventVendor = "Aruba Networks"
        , EventSchema = "Authentication"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , EventSeverity
        , EventOriginalSeverity = LogSeverity
        , EventOriginalType = Activity
        , EventMessage = Reason
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , TargetUsername = _TargetUsername
        , User = _TargetUsername
        , TargetUsernameType
        , TargetUserType
        , TargetOriginalUserType
        , TargetSimpleUsername
        , TargetUserUpn
        , TargetWindowsUsername
        , TargetDomain = iff(_UserDomainOk, _UserDomain, "")
        , TargetDomainType = case(
            not(_UserDomainOk), ""
            , _UserDomain has ".", "FQDN"
            , "Windows")
        , TargetHostname = _TargetHostname
        // Some records carry the  string "unknown" instead of a real IP
        , TargetIpAddr = iff(isnotnull(parse_ipv4(DestinationIP)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(DestinationIP)), DestinationIP, "")
        , Dst = iff(isnotempty(_TargetHostname), _TargetHostname, DestinationIP)
        , TargetAppName = DestinationServiceName
        , TargetAppType = iff(isnotempty(DestinationServiceName), "Service", "")
        , Application = DestinationServiceName
        , LogonTarget = DestinationServiceName
        , LogonMethod
        , SrcIpAddr = SourceIP
        , IpAddr = SourceIP
        , SrcFQDN = _SrcFQDN
        , SrcHostname = case(
            _SrcHostnameOk, _SrcHostnameFromSpn
            , isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SourceIP)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SourceIP)), SourceIP
            , "")
        , SrcDomain = iff(_SrcDomainOk, _SrcDomainFromSpn, "")
        , SrcDomainType = case(
            not(_SrcDomainOk), ""
            , _SrcDomainFromSpn has ".", "FQDN"
            , "Windows")
        , Src = case(
            isnotempty(_SrcFQDN), _SrcFQDN
            , _SrcHostnameOk, _SrcHostnameFromSpn
            , isnotempty(SourceIP), SourceIP
            , "")
        , Dvc = DeviceAddress
        , DvcIpAddr = DeviceAddress
        , DvcHostname = DeviceName
        , AdditionalFields
        , Type = "CommonSecurityLog"
};
vimAuthenticationArubaNetworksClearPass(
    starttime=starttime
    , endtime=endtime
    , srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix
    , srchostname_has_any=srchostname_has_any
    , username_has_any=username_has_any
    , targetappname_has_any=targetappname_has_any
    , eventtype_in=eventtype_in
    , eventresult=eventresult
    , eventresultdetails_in=eventresultdetails_in
    , disabled=disabled
    , pack=pack
)
